items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: And when I heard Erskine Hawkins and 'Tuxedo Junction' on RCA, I flipped, because it was a much better recording than I had, you know.

ctx.x: Erskine Hawkins came up here and they give him a date -- he got a date on RCA Victor! RCA, you know.
